article.title: Faith-Labor Organizing: Why Building Permanent Infrastructure is the Intervention This Moment Demands
article.author: Kenneth Nixon
article.content: Our congregations and our unions each have a measure of power. None of it is enough. The change we seek requires building power together; prioritizing building that power together in parallel with the work we are already doing alone. Our faith communities and labor unions share geographies, serve many of the same families, and claim a common commitment to human dignity. We rarely build power… Source
